title: Solar battery sizing example
body: A battery rated at 1.2 kilowatt-hours can theoretically deliver 120 watts for ten hours. Actual usable energy is lower because of depth-of-discharge limits and conversion losses. Size a system using the appliance load in watts multiplied by operating hours, then account for inverter efficiency and usable battery fraction.

title: Water treatment comparison example
body: Boiling can inactivate many pathogens but does not remove chemical contaminants. A filter designed for protozoa does not necessarily remove viruses or dissolved chemicals. Treatment choices depend on the suspected hazards and the manufacturer's verified performance specifications.
